_comment: Control: persona A's weights with no screen and two options (Plunkett's dot-product rule). On Qwen/Qwen3-14B.
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31; screen: none.
The data folder is the Qwen3-8B experiment's: trials and answers do not depend on the model.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-14B on a 24 GB card (L4, A10, RTX 4090, RTX 3090): micro_batch_size 2, eval batches 4 (decision 4, introspection 1). Qwen3-14B in 4-bit is about 10 GB, as tight on 24 GB as 8B is on 16 GB. Out of memory: micro_batch_size 1, then report_schema.max_new_tokens 200.
Run: python scripts/run_one_persona.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona_qwen3_14b/controls/persona_a/one_persona_linear_14b_24gb.json
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over default.json (those values are now written out here too):
One-persona dot-product control: persona A with the screen taken away. The same persona and attributes
(loose_leaf_tea, 'Imagine you are Djedefre'), A's weights (caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38,
steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31) and Plunkett's linear rule: the option with the higher weighted sum of
range-normalised values wins. No cut, so no C: two options, Plunkett's A-or-B decision prompt.
Asks whether self-report behaves differently when the rule is a plain dot product, with nothing else changed that can
be kept: the model, LoRA, learning rate, batch, 5000 training trials, 3000 steps, a checkpoint every 250 (the
untrained model as step 0), clipping 1.0, 1000 estimation trials and 1000 natural validation trials per checkpoint,
50 samples per report question, the "{" reply prefix, show_neither (a no-op here: two options), the seeds.
Necessarily different from the threshold runs: the decision prompt offers A or B only (no C line), so the training
prompts are not A's 5000; and only weight questions are asked (no screen exists to ask about):
main, main_trial_first   shown a trial, 50 samples each
main_no_trial            no trial, no mention of a threshold, asked once
Extends default.json (not the threshold files), since a merged file cannot drop the threshold rule's fields.
data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/controls/persona_a/one_persona_linear/: A's input files, instilled_weights.csv cut to the five weight columns (the other 1099
rows kept for the cross-persona null). Build (once, LF line endings):
python data/general/vector_dataset_constructor.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/controls/persona_a/one_persona_linear.json
